reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a group holding a format 2 OCCURS is referenced: with data-name-1 outside the group the operation uses only the part given by data-name-1's value at the start of the operation, sending or receiving; with data-name-1 inside the group, a sending reference uses that current part and a receiving reference uses the group's maximum length.
reader.edition-search: Grepped OdoModel.cs, PlaceBuilder.cs, RecordLayout.cs, PlaceRenderer.cs and GroupImageCodec.cs for DialectLevel|EditionContext|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior|Edition.: no match. The direction rule is the single expression UsesCurrentExtent = dir == Sending || !DependingInside.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb202_odo_refmod_group_direction covers reference-modified and whole-group sending, and a reference-modified receiver with data-name-1 inside; the whole-group RECEIVER with data-name-1 outside (GR3a's receiving half), the whole-group receiver with data-name-1 inside, group-to-group moves, comparisons and READ INTO are not exercised.

probes.expected: GR3a: data-name-1 outside, MM=2: receiver takes 6 characters, rest unchanged; sender sends 6; comparison on 6
GR3b: receiver with data-name-1 inside takes the maximum 16 positions (NN becomes 3); sender uses current extent
MOVE G TO G2: sender's extent from NN at the start (10), receiver maximum (11) so the statement itself changes KK to 3; MOVE G TO H uses MM at the start (6)
READ INTO a group with data-name-1 inside: maximum length; INTO a group with data-name-1 outside (MM=2): 6 characters

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3a  (5.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3a
OK  §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3b  (5.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3b

reader.notes: The binder wraps every group over an ODO table as an OdoGroupPlace that records whether data-name-1 is inside, and the renderer picks the current extent or the maximum image from the access direction alone; no edition is read. MOVE SPACES to a group with data-name-1 inside blanks the count (B9), which is the program's own error, not the compiler's (VI.5.8.4 GR2b requires the value in range).

MOVE "5*****" TO H, MOVE 1 TO HN, MOVE 2 TO PTR, STRING "ab" DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO H WITH POINTER PTR, MOVE 5 TO HN, DISPLAY H PTR. Expected [5ab***][04]: H is the STRING receiving item (VI.6.25.4 GR1), so its maximum length 6 is used (VI.5.8.4 GR3b), and positions not written stay unchanged (GR4a no space filling, GR8). Printed S2[5a    ][03]: the receiver was taken at its CURRENT extent (2 positions), only 'a' moved, and positions 3-6 were overwritten with spaces. S4 (POINTER 3 > current extent): ON OVERFLOW taken although position 3 is within the 6-position maximum, and H's positions 3-6 were still blanked: [5*    ][03].
